title: v0.2.0
featureLines: **OpenVINO back end** — runs on the GPU, then the CPU, then falls back to ONNX Runtime (#4).
**Photo → splats (`SPLATS_MONO`)** — a new job capability that turns one photo into a 3D Gaussian splat PLY (#4).
**SHARP model pack** — `packs/dxr-open-sharp.models.json` lists two builds, `sharp-int4-1536` and `sharp-full-1536` (#5, #6).
**`MODEL` setting** — `auto` picks the full build on a GPU machine with at least 16 GB of RAM and the int4 build otherwise; either can be forced (#6).
**Warm-up fix** — warming a model now waits for the model store's verify to finish instead of timing out after 5 s (#7).
Core ML execution provider on macOS with CPU fallback and cached compiles (source builds; no macOS package in this release) (#2).

title: v1.22.0
featureLines: **A smoother everyday player.** Closing no longer hangs on a file from a stalled network share, Cyrillic and Greek file names display correctly, and the player gains a full screen button, a projection picker, a shortcuts panel (F1 / ?) a…
**A Settings window.** Preferences now live in one per-user settings file, editable from a Settings window (gear button, Ctrl+, or the "Settings..." menu row).

**Pro stereo QC.** The rig check now measures left/right scale (zoom) mismatch and per-channel colour (gain/lift, with ASC CDL export and a colour-difference overlay), plus a live disparity readout, cursor probe and heatmap.
**Pro media browser.** An opt-in Open dialog on Windows with image-sequence tiles and thumbnails.

title: v0.37.0
featureLines: **Hands look like hands.** Each tracked hand is now drawn as one continuous, translucent skinned surface instead of a set of capsules. Set `DXR_MODELVIEWER_HANDS_LOOK=capsules` to get the old look back.
**Pinch works the same at any hand scale.** The pinch thresholds follow the tracked palm length, so a hand mapped with a gain, or scaled to the window, pinches at the same finger posture.

**Pinch-drag turns the model by the same amount in any window size.** Drag distance is measured in full-display metres, so a drag across a small window turns the model as far as the same drag across the whole screen.

**macOS transparent background.** Ctrl/Cmd+T switches to a see-through background with click-through (clicks outside the model reach the desktop) and keeps the window above others, as on Windows and Linux.

Hands: the rigged GenericHand mesh from the Ultraleap Unity plug-in (Apache-2.0), embedded as an asset and CPU-skinned from the 26 OpenXR hand-tracking joints; capsules stay available via `DXR_MODELVIEWER_HANDS_LOOK=capsules` (#183).

macOS: transparent background (Ctrl/Cmd+T, `MODEL_TRANSPARENT=1` / `--transparent`), alpha-coverage click-through, keep-above while transparent, and `XR_DXR_depth_budget` clip-plane support (#181, #182).
